name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source browser API for AI agents: Chromium sessions for Puppeteer, Playwright and Selenium, scrape, screenshot and PDF endpoints, and a UI to watch sessions live.

alerts.message: Steel Browser has no authentication of its own, so a gateway guards the domain. Open https://<your-domain>/ui and sign in as admin with STEEL_UI_PASSWORD from the environment settings. Programs use the generated STEEL_API_KEY: the Steel SDK sends it as the steel-api-key header (set STEEL_BASE_URL=https://<your-domain> and STEEL_API_KEY), and Playwright or Puppeteer add apiKey=<key> as a query parameter to the session's websocketUrl. Anyone with the key can make the browser fetch any URL, including services on your private network.
